/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/sarkar-husain.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
header, body = original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
metadata, roman = header.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
changes = [
    ('Sultan Husain Maula sarkaar Husain Maula', 'Sultan Husain Maula Sultan Husain Maula'),
    ('Ghar baar lutaaya hai diṅ us ka basaane ko', 'Ghar baar lutaaya hai diṅ us ka basaana ko'),
    ('Ghaazi bhi diya tu ne', 'Ghaazi bhi tu ne'),
    ('Ye jaan bhale jaaye', 'Ye jaan bhalaa jaaye'),
    ('Ye hathkari ye beri', 'Ye hathkari ye beri'),
]
for old, new in changes:
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
source_blocks = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
roman_blocks = roman.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source_blocks) == len(roman_blocks) == 10
count = 0
for i, (source, transliteration) in enumerate(zip(source_blocks, roman_blocks)):
    source_lines, roman_lines = source.splitlines(), transliteration.splitlines()
    assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
    if i >= 2:
        assert source_lines.pop(0) == '۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸'[i - 2]
        assert roman_lines.pop(0).strip() == str(i - 1)
    count += len(source_lines)
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman)
p.write_bytes((metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
print(f'{count} verses in each edition')
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/sarkar-husain.md && git diff -- src/data/lyrics/sarkar-husain.md"

item.text:
Audited [sarkar-husain.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/0048da950bbc48629b510515671faec3/src/data/lyrics/sarkar-husain.md) verse by verse. Corrected the recurring `Sultan Husain Maula` refrain, removed an extra `diya`, and adjusted two vowels to match the Urdu. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved.

Verified 61 verses in each version, including the opening blocks, with all eight numbered stanzas aligned. The scanner’s 60-line Roman count did not reproduce.
